C1459.title: Research on Architectural Side-Channel Vulnerabilities in IoT Devices
C1459.summary: A 2025 ACDSA conference paper examined IoT side-channel risks from an architectural perspective. The authors analyzed information exposure through observable properties of resource-constrained devices, including power consumption, electromagnetic emanations, and execution timing; discussed how such non-functional signals may reveal internal processing activity; and summarized hardware and software exposure points that designers should mitigate.
